app/src/main/java/com/entercomm/bikeinte.description: WiFi Direct service discovery configuration constants added in WiFiDirect object. Detekt requires underscores in numeric literals >= 10000.

ConnectionCoordinator now synchronizes group code between WiFiDirectManager and MeshNetworkManager. setGroupCode() propagates to both managers. The handleGroupCodeChanged event handler also syncs to MeshNetworkManager when WiFi Direct group code changes externally. Use @Suppress("TooManyFunctions") for coordinator classes that legitimately need many methods.
